requirements.requirement: a candidate moves applied, screening, interview, offer, hired in that order; back one stage is fine, back further is not; rejected and withdrawn are the end
a vacancy view with candidates by stage, a candidate view with panel, scores and notes, and a funnel showing where people are lost
the funnel shows how many reached each stage and how many left at it, matching the hand-worked joiner figures
the funnel is worked out from where candidates are and have been, not from a count anybody stores
TypeScript bundled with esbuild, the funnel drawn with d3, Express and SQLite, at /workspace/pellmoor-job-pipeline on port 3000 from public/index.html
sign-in is required and the four demo accounts use password123
the hiring manager moves people, the coordinator adds candidates and arranges panels, panel members score, everyone may note
load the seed exactly, keeping the ids the paper file quotes
a vacancy nobody has applied to yet should say so rather than drawing an empty chart
the pipeline is durable and coherent across its views
